conviction_note: Findings sum to -4.3; I emit -5.0 because this name's own distribution is fat-tailed (3 of 7 prints beyond 10%, the equivalent FY print last year -17.93%) and lesson 8 says not to round a thin-float name toward zero. The fundamental read is near flat (-1.0) because EXXUA's ramp offsets the ADHD collapse almost exactly against the only sourceable bar, but the reaction read is negative and separate: this stock has never paid for the reported quarter (a -33% revenue quarter bought +0.89% in May) and has twice been sold hard on the spend/outlook line (-17.93% on the FY25 print, -10.31% on the launch-spend Q2), which is exactly what a full-year release aggregating a +$9.2m-to-about-minus-$7.5m adjusted-EBITDA swing puts on the page. The honest counterweight, which I have already deducted for in finding 2, is that the Q4 GAAP headline will look far cleaner than last year's -$2.92 EPS quarter because the warrants were reclassified to equity on 2026-03-31 and there is no derivative line left to blow the loss out.
bar: FY2026 revenue $53.75m (3 analysts) — https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aytu/forecast/, read 2026-09-22. Reported 9M FY26 revenue is $41.47m (13.89 + 15.17 + 12.41), so the bar implies a Q4 of $12.28m. SINGLE SOURCE: WSJ and Nasdaq estimate pages were both unreachable from this container, so per lesson 6 every size on this name is capped small and the EPS consensus (-$1.14 FY26) is explicitly NOT used — 9M actual EPS is already -$1.66, so that number is either non-GAAP or stale and cannot anchor anything.
positioning_check: 334,399 shares short = 4.43% of a 7.56m float, 10.47 days to cover, 3.12% of shares outstanding — https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aytu/statistics/, read 2026-09-22. NOT a crowded short: the 10.47 days-to-cover is an artefact of 26,037 shares/day of average volume, not of a large position, so there is no squeeze mechanism that would shrink a negative here. There is NO option chain (baseline: options.status = no_options_market), so there is no 25-delta skew and the market makes no directional statement out loud on this name at all. The only price-based statement is the tape: run_up_20d -0.87% (free control ~flat, says nothing) against run_up_5d +15.08%, and that five-session move is the positioning fact I size in finding 6.

findings.finding: The company's own quarterly path puts Q4 FY26 revenue at roughly $11.5-12.5m against the $12.28m the only sourceable consensus implies, because Q4 is the first FULL quarter of the Adzenys authorized-generic mix shift that cut Q3 ADHD revenue to $9.1m from $13.2m in each of Q1 and Q2, layered on the seasonal June-quarter ADHD trough (FY25 went $15.4m in Q3 to $13.1m in Q4).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name does not pay on the reported quarter. On 2026-05-13 AYTU printed net revenue of $12.4m against $18.5m, a 33% year-on-year decline, and the stock moved +0.89% (baseline history). Q1 FY26 at $13.9m moved +1.46%. That is why this finding is sized at a fraction of the arithmetic and why print_vs_bar_pct and expected_move_pct disagree.
findings.why_not_priced: Three analysts carry an FY26 number and nobody has published a Q4 split; if the $12.28m implied quarter were being actively modelled the stock would not have added 15.08% in five sessions on 26k shares a day with the company silent since the 16 September date announcement. What would be visibly different if it were priced: a published Q4 revenue estimate somewhere, and a flat-to-down tape into the print rather than a five-day squeeze.
findings.independence: The ADHD mix shift is corroborated independently of the release by the Q3 FY26 10-Q's description of the branded-to-generic Adzenys transition and the associated $0.7m inventory write-down, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001385818/000143774926016721/aytu20260331_10q.htm. NOTE: this finding shares the 2026-05-13 release with finding 2 and finding 5 — it is the revenue line, finding 2 is the profit line and its separately-guided Q4 opex step-up, finding 5 is the forward EXXUA line. They are not three readings of one number and they are consistent: my own Q4 build already embeds the EXXUA growth in finding 5 and still lands at or below the bar, which is the net-of-the-rest-of-the-company check (ADHD ~62% of Q4 revenue falling, EXXUA ~31% rising).

findings.finding: FY2026 adjusted EBITDA swings to roughly minus $7.5m from plus $9.2m in FY2025 — a ~$17m reversal on a $24.6m market cap — and Q4 is the worst quarter of the year by design, because management guided on the Q3 call that Q4 sales and marketing would rise $1-2m and G&A $0.2-0.3m sequentially off an already negative $2.8m Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the line that has paid on this name, twice. The equivalent full-year print on 2025-09-23 — which carried GOOD revenue (FY25 $66.4m, +2%) and a POSITIVE $9.2m adjusted EBITDA but outlined the EXXUA launch spend — fell 17.93%. The 2026-02-03 Q2 print, which was launch spend with $0.2m of EXXUA stocking revenue against it, fell 10.31%. The two largest negative reactions in the baseline are both on the spend/outlook line, not on revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: The four quarterly adjusted-EBITDA figures (-0.6, -0.8, -2.8 and a guided-worse Q4) have never been added up in one place, and a full-year release is precisely where they get added up on the first line of the table. If this were priced there would be a published FY26 EBITDA estimate to check it against, and the stock would not have rallied into it.
findings.independence: Corroborated from a different document: reported operating income per quarter runs +$0.64m (Q4 FY25), -$1.50m, -$1.97m, -$4.06m through Q3 FY26 — a monotonic deterioration independent of the non-GAAP definition, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aytu/financials/?p=quarterly. Sized down from my draft for a real counterweight rather than left gross: last year's FY-print quarter carried a -$19.8m net loss and -$2.92 EPS, almost all of it warrant remeasurement, and the warrants were reclassified to equity on 2026-03-31, so Q4 FY26 has NO derivative line and the GAAP headline will be materially cleaner than the one that produced -17.93%.

findings.finding: Cash falls to roughly $21-23m at 30 June 2026 from $26.7m at 31 March and $31.0m at the start of the year, against $10.4m drawn on an Eclipse Business Capital revolver whose $14.5m borrowing base is receivables-driven and therefore shrinking with the ADHD revenue that generates it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No financing event sits in the baseline's seven reactions, so there is no reaction history on this line for this name and I size it accordingly. The nearest analogue is the June 2025 upsized at-the-market public offering with full overallotment exercise, which was not an earnings-date event.
findings.why_not_priced: A full-year release plus the 10-K is where a liquidity paragraph or a concurrent capital raise would surface, and with 10.73m shares outstanding a raise is unusually dilutive per share; if the market were pricing that, the pre-print tape would not be +15% in five days. What would look different if priced: put demand, which cannot exist here because there is no chain, or a discount to the $26.7m cash balance rather than an enterprise value of $20.8m.
findings.independence: THE FINANCING QUESTION, ANSWERED, AND THE ANSWER SHRANK THIS FINDING from my draft -1.5 to -0.5. What the money buys is corroborated demand, not a hole: EXXUA scripts went 700 in March to over 920 in April (+26% month-on-month), units shipped +51% sequentially in April, prescriptions in 41-42 states, and management stated net selling price across government and commercial is 'materially higher than we initially budgeted' (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/13/aytu-aytu-q3-2026-earnings-transcript/). There is no going-concern language in the Q3 10-Q and no covenant breach disclosed. This is financing that funds a visible ramp, so it is close to a zero and is kept only as an overhang.

findings.finding: The 30 June fiscal year end is the annual intangible impairment testing date, AYTU carries $42.49m of intangibles that are overwhelmingly ADHD and pediatric product rights, the ADHD line is running 41% below prior year and is being deliberately deemphasised, and the Metadate CD licence from Lannett was terminated by mutual agreement on 23 June 2026 — seven days before the fiscal year closed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY25 print quarter carried a -$19.8m net loss and -$2.92 EPS and the stock fell 17.93%, so this shareholder base has demonstrably NOT looked through a blown-out fourth-quarter GAAP loss on this name. Filed under reported_quarter rather than one_off on the lessons rule that an unquantified reported-quarter impairment lands on the line and is not in the price.
findings.why_not_priced: The Metadate termination 8-K was filed on 25 June into a name with 26k shares a day of volume and no coverage; it frames its own materiality downward ('Net revenue of Metadate CD reported by the Company for the Quarter Ended March 31, 2026 was $49,000') while saying the full Termination Agreement will only be filed with the annual report, so the carrying-value consequence is deferred to exactly tonight's document. If the market had priced an impairment, stockholders' equity of $35.1m would not be supporting a $24.6m market cap the way it currently appears to.
findings.independence: Separate document, separate fact: the $42.49m intangible balance at 31 March 2026 is from the balance sheet, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aytu/financials/balance-sheet/?p=quarterly. This is the weakest-evidenced finding in the set — I can source the trigger conditions and the dated licence termination but I cannot source that a charge WILL be taken or its size, which is why it is sized at -1.0 with a band running to zero rather than at the dollars involved.

findings.finding: EXXUA's disclosed monthly trajectory implies its best quarter by a wide margin — Q3's $2.4m came on over 3,200 channel units while April alone shipped over 1,300 units (+51% sequential) on over 920 scripts (+26% month-on-month from 700 in March) — and management will be quoting August/September script data on tonight's call that exists nowhere in the public record, while the third-party generic threat to Adzenys has proved weak at only about 14% market share after four-plus months.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only large positive in the baseline is +91.85% on 2025-05-14, which is what a 7.56m float does when the forward story changes. The 2026-05-13 print, where the April script datapoint was first given, held the stock flat (+0.89%) despite a 33% revenue decline — so the forward EXXUA line has already demonstrated it can offset an ugly reported quarter on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Five months of compounding at the disclosed rate has never been reported: no wire, no aggregator and no analyst has published an EXXUA script number after April, and the only company communication since 23 June is the 16 September date announcement. If the market held current script data, a stock with three estimates and a $24.6m cap would show it in coverage or in volume rather than 26k shares a day.
findings.independence: The 14% third-party generic share figure is management's and therefore shares the transcript with the first half of this finding; the independent corroboration of the launch itself is the Q3 press release's 'more than 1,300 prescriptions written in the quarter by more than 450 unique prescribers' and 'more than 3,200 units', https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1385818/000143774926016717/ex_918589.htm. This is the finding that keeps the set from being a one-sided pessimism artefact, and its high band of +8.0 is deliberate: it is the side of the distribution that has produced +91.85% on this name.

findings.finding: The stock has added 15.08% in five sessions on 26,037 shares a day of average volume with no company news of any kind since the 16 September earnings-date announcement, and the 20-day run-up is -0.87% — so the entire move is a five-day pre-print bid into a 7.56m float, with short interest at 4.43% far too small to be its cause or to squeeze against a disappointment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The directly comparable event — the FY2025 full-year print on 2025-09-23, the same annual release one year earlier — fell 17.93%, and it fell on a release that carried better revenue and positive adjusted EBITDA than anything tonight can carry. A full-year print is where this shareholder base has historically taken money off the table.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a fact about who owns the stock going in rather than about the company, and it is the fact the baseline most conspicuously cannot carry: with no option chain there is no skew and therefore no market statement about the risk, and the sealed baseline's expected_move_pct of 1.46% is a median of a distribution running -17.93% to +91.85%, which under-describes the event by an order of magnitude. If this run-up were informed rather than anticipatory, there would be a news item behind it and there is none.
findings.independence: The tape numbers are from the sealed baseline (spot 2.29, run_up_5d_pct 15.08, run_up_20d_pct -0.87, avg_volume_20d 26,037), the news-absence check is the separate stocktitan feed, and the short-interest side is https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aytu/statistics/. This finding deliberately AGREES with the short-window price action reversing rather than fighting it, so it is not a sign taken against a positioning signal.

outside_window.finding: UnitedHealthcare added updated step-therapy and prior-authorisation criteria for Exxua effective 1 September 2026 — a coverage restriction at the largest commercial payer that pressures the 'over 70% of commercial claims approved on first attempt' figure management gave in May, but whose revenue effect lands in FY2027 quarters reported long after this exit window.

Granules' Paragraph IV certification against Adzenys XR-ODT triggered a patent suit filed 11 December 2024 and a 30-month FDA approval stay that runs into 2027; resolution of that stay, not tonight's print, is what settles whether the ADHD portfolio erodes further.

searched_and_found_nothing: No S-3 shelf, 424B prospectus supplement, ATM supplement or warrant amendment on EDGAR between 13 May 2026 and today — the only filings since the Q3 10-Q are the 25 June Metadate termination 8-K, eight Form 4s on 30 July and a third-party 13G/A on 14 August, so the 'full-year report beside a capital event' hypothesis has no filing trail behind it as of today

The 14 August Schedule 13G/A is Laurence W. Lytton and the Lytton-Kambara Foundation at 4.99% each as of 30 June 2026 — both pinned exactly at a 4.99% blocker on warrants rather than reporting a position change, so it carries no directional information

The reported Exxua 'shortage' is a March 2026 content-farm article about RxConnect distribution access, explicitly NOT an FDA-listed shortage — checked the date on the page, it is 10 March 2026 and it predates everything already known

The June 2026 corporate presentation (dated 6-10-26 on the IR site) is an image-only PDF and could not be rendered in this container — no poppler, and the extractor returned JPEG streams — so any post-April script data it may carry is unread
Hiring pages (ZipRecruiter, Indeed, Colorado Bioscience) show generic open sales-representative postings with no datable change in headcount or team structure, so no hiring signal either way
No sell-side preview, no rating change and no note of any kind on AYTU since the May quarter
Nasdaq and WSJ estimate pages both unreachable (503 / blocked), so the FY2026 revenue bar rests on a single source and every size here is capped accordingly
baseline_tension: There is nothing in the baseline to cut against — no option chain, no skew, a 20-day run-up of -0.87% that leaves the free control silent, and an expected_move_pct of 1.46% that is a median of a -17.93%-to-+91.85% distribution and describes nothing; what I found cuts against the ONE live price signal, the +15.08% five-day bid into the print, and it agrees with the single most comparable event in the history, the same annual release a year ago at -17.93%.
lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question) cut the cash/revolver finding from -1.5 to -0.5: I asked what the money buys and the answer is a corroborated ramp — scripts +26% month-on-month, units +51%, 41-42 states, net price above budget, no going-concern language — which the rule classes as a positive or a zero, not the negative I had drafted.

Lesson 1 (the reaction function vetoes the fundamental read) cut the revenue-versus-bar finding from -1.5 to -0.8: this name printed a 33% revenue decline in May and moved +0.89%, so the reported-quarter line does not pay here however good the arithmetic is. It is also why print_vs_bar_pct (-1.0) and expected_move_pct (-5.0) are deliberately far apart.

Lesson 2 moved the impairment finding from one_off to reported_quarter — the file's stated exception is that an unquantified reported-quarter impairment lands on the line and is not in the price — and the size was left at -1.0 because I can source the trigger and the dated Metadate licence termination but not the charge.

Lesson 3 (your own caveat must reach the number) cut the adjusted-EBITDA finding from -3.0 to -2.5. The counterweight I had written into the text but not into the size is that the warrants were reclassified to equity on 2026-03-31, so unlike the -$2.92 EPS quarter that produced last year's -17.93% there is no derivative line left to blow out tonight's GAAP headline.

Lesson 6 (verify the bar) is the binding constraint on the whole name: WSJ and Nasdaq estimate pages were both unreachable, the FY2026 revenue bar rests on one source, and the FY2026 EPS consensus of -$1.14 was discarded outright because 9M actual EPS is already -$1.66. Every size above is capped small for that reason and `bar` says so.

Lesson 8 (thin coverage means a confirmed fact moves more) is why expected_move_pct is -5.0 against a finding sum of -4.3 rather than being rounded toward zero — the name's own distribution has 3 of 7 prints beyond 10% on a 7.56m float.

Lesson 9 (size a segment finding net of the rest) is why print_vs_bar_pct is only -1.0: I am bearish on ADHD, which is ~62% of the Q4 quarter, and bullish on EXXUA at ~31%, and the net against the only sourceable bar is close to flat.

The pessimism-artefact note was applied to the set: five of six findings lean negative, which is the shape the file warns about, so the EXXUA finding's high band was left at +8.0 rather than trimmed, because that is the side of this name's distribution that has produced +91.85%.
